rows.grounds: compound nominative singular masculine; internal sandhi fused

items.question: What removal of curse and defect has the devotee heard from the lord?
premises: Mantras were heard from the lord.
Curse and defect removal was heard.
items.inference: The speaker has received from the lord the removal of curses and defects.
items.plain_english: The removal of curse and defect has been heard by me from you, lord.
